scripts.predev: npm run build -w @dor/contracts && npm run build -w @dor/agents
scripts.prebuild:app: npm run build -w @dor/contracts && npm run build -w @dor/agents
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dor/contracts && npm run build -w @dor/agents && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:module: npm run build -w @dor/contracts && npm run check -w @dor/spacetimedb-module
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:module && npm run typecheck && npm run test:app
scripts.ai:build: npm run build -w @dor/contracts && npm run build -w @dor/agents && npm run build -w @dor/worker
scripts.ai:check: npm run ai:build && npm test -w @dor/agents && npm test -w @dor/worker && npm run test:integration -w @dor/worker
scripts.ai:live: npm run ai:build && npm run live -w @dor/agents && npm run live -w @dor/worker
scripts.ai:dryrun: npm run ai:build && npm run test:integration -w @dor/worker -- full-dry-run
